verdict.rationale: Airweave is positioned as search/retrieval infrastructure (vector search, agentic tool-calling search, MCP server, CLI) that lets external AI agents query synced data — the evidence never shows Airweave itself generating insights, summaries, or proactive suggestions from the data inside its own product/UI. Missing for 10: any documentation of an insights/analytics dashboard, generated summaries, or proactive suggestion feature.
